paper_title: A double-blind, 377-subject randomized study identifies Ruminococcus, Coprococcus, Christensenella, and Collinsella as long-term potential key players in the modulation of the gut microbiome of lactose intolerant individuals by galacto-oligosaccharides

pico.outcome: investigate the changes the fecal microbiome of 377 patients with lactose intolerance (LI), randomized to one of two doses of GOS (GOS High or GOS Low doses), or placebo

supplement: After the intervention period, lactose was administered to all groups to measure glucose tolerance.
